source: sars-guide:PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Rev 1 p. 28 (non-standard employment, at least 5 hours per day, earns more than R394 that day: 25% deduction); p. 28 "calculated and deducted at 25% on the balance of remuneration"
notes: Non-standard employment, 6 hours a day at R500 a day for 10 days = R5 000. Over R394 a day, so 25% of the balance of remuneration: R1 250.00 (G21 p. 28, summary table row 4). The tables give nil (60 000 is under the threshold). Only PAYE is asserted. Complements sage-2027-03-marco (Sage's flat 25% with no hours).
